description: This file defines navigation item types and a list of navigation items with associated routes, labels, and icons for a React frontend project.

methods.name: NavIcon
methods.description: A type alias for icon components that are renderable as JSX Elements, ensuring type safety for icon rendering in navigation.

methods.name: NavItem
methods.description: Type for navigation items, including route path, label, and icon component.

methods.name: NAV_ITEMS
methods.description: An array of navigation items with specific routes, labels, and associated icons for use in the application's navigation menu.

ctags.name: to
ctags.pattern: /^  { to: "\/", label: "Landing", icon: FaClipboardList as unknown as NavIcon },$/

ctags.name: to
ctags.pattern: /^  { to: "\/app\/assets", label: "Assets", icon: FaTable as unknown as NavIcon },$/

ctags.name: to
ctags.pattern: /^  { to: "\/app\/assets\/create", label: "Create", icon: FaPlusCircle as unknown as NavIcon },$/
